resources.name: Cloudflare edge and Worker runtime
resources.purpose: Intended DNS, routing, Worker runtime and public asset delivery
evidence: Cloudflare account subdomain is thelingolegacy; workers.dev is enabled for both staging control-center and flagship Worker.
Production main Worker deployment is version 137 (100%) under deployment ecd71a70-e476-4318-92a7-35249ced360b; latest uploaded version 305 is preview-only and unpromoted.

The current uploaded flagship Worker source-map sourcesContent matches canonical GitHub main worker.js byte-for-byte under an FNV-1a comparison (8b8ff92d); this proves uploaded-source parity only, not active deployment version 137 parity.
Active version 137 metadata confirms fetch handler, ASSETS binding, CANONICAL_DOMAIN and PUBLIC_SITE_URL bindings, and edge security-header configuration.

Cloudflare telemetry on 2026-11-12 returned zero invocation events for lingo-studio-control-center-staging; staging source code statically contains /healthz, GET/HEAD-only handling, noindex, security headers and productionMutation:false, but live HTTP runtime is unverified.

A production Worker telemetry aggregation for 2026-11-12 returned a 404 response bucket with count 640 (sample interval 10); inspected samples were scanner probes for common secrets, config, admin and framework paths and returned 404. No successful end-user route check was established from those samples.

Runtime probe attempt through the available Cloudflare execution sandbox was blocked before reaching origin by sandbox outbound-network policy; production/staging origin HTTP response remains unobserved through this path.
